title: 8 Best Anything Alternatives in 2026: Honest Comparison
summary: Anything alternatives ranked by backend depth, pricing predictability, and real-world use. Blink, Base44, Bolt, Lovable, Softr, Bubble — honest pros and cons.
body_markdown: Blink and Base44 are the two clearest answers. Blink exposes 62 MCP tools across the whole platform plus a hosted Claude and ChatGPT connector, so a Blink-built app is agent-callable by construction. Base44's App MCP gives each individual published app its own OAuth-scoped server. Anything, Lovable, Softr, Replit, Bubble, Bolt, and v0 don't document a comparable surface for the apps they generate.
